title: FrameworkInteraction
description: Framework base Archetype for Interaction — the single GSM primitive relation, Effector to Receptor. Inherits gsm/Interaction through the top-level $ref and composes the catalogue-wide FrameworkAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Interaction statement distributed by this repository MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Interaction, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: gsm-frameworks (framework foundation).
